critique.evidence: The before/after ledger, repeated 25.60× result, ROI formula, and “Review the adaptive arena” CTA make the metric and next action easy to locate on desktop and mobile. However, the core conclusion is internally confusing: the copy says the defense “wins the campaign,” while the result is explicitly “Above break-even” with attacker ROI still at 25.60×, so the attacker remains highly profitable. “Measured” also lacks a visible time window, attempt denominator, or fraud-value input needed to interpret the result. On tablet, the navigation bar overlays the headline and supporting sentence, obscuring the claim.
critique.fix: Rewrite the conclusion to match the evidence—for example, “Detection cuts attacker ROI from 545.35× to 25.60×, but does not yet make attacks unprofitable”—and state the next objective as driving ROI below 0×. Add the measurement window, total attempts, and assumed fraud value beside the formula. Fix the tablet header so it never covers the headline or explanatory copy.
